hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in */SKILL.md|SKILL.md) : ;; *) exit 0;; esac; if [ "$(head -c3 "$f")" != "---" ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"$f: SKILL.md должен начинаться с YAML frontmatter (---).\"}}"; exit 0; fi; fm_end=$(awk 'NR>1 && /^---[[:space:]]*$/{print NR; exit}' "$f"); if [ -z "$fm_end" ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"$f: YAML frontmatter не закрыт второй строкой ---.\"}}"; exit 0; fi; body=$(sed -n "2,$((fm_end-1))p" "$f"); err=""; echo "$body" | grep -q "^name:" || err="${err:+$err }$f: в frontmatter нет поля name."; echo "$body" | grep -q "^description:" || err="${err:+$err }$f: в frontmatter нет поля description."; if [ -n "$err" ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"$err\"}}"; fi; exit 0; } 2>/dev/null || true
